text: I love this app! The AI function helped me break down some really complex tasks into smaller ones, that I could then tweak to fit a.o. my language and pace. Just having a 'simple' and 'extended' morning routine with alarms at the end of each task helps me to stay on track and not get distracted. After an update I couldn't find my lists. I posted here and developer Thomas reacted the same day! That's service! Thanks so much for developing this app, Thomas. I will get the paid version when I can
author: Gonny van de Straat
developer_reply: Can you try to tap on the plus icon and then tap on the library? Your lists are probably still in there, the app just shifted to recording the items by the day, so they are assigned to the day you created them. Sorry for the inconvenience! You can email me at thomas@neurolist.app if you have further questions.
